Title: TFGTRS-4604 - Custom preferences are renamed and sale vs full price controls are clearly separated
Pre-Condition: Business Manager access on dev. The exact preference names and pricebooks per brand are pending confirmation from the developer.
Steps:
1. Open the Custom Preferences group that controls the automated £ / % badges.
2. Check the names of the preferences.
Expected: There are separate controls for sale / hard markdown products and for full price products, with names that make the difference clear.

Title: TFGTRS-4604 - Full price badge switched off: no badge on full price promoted products
Pre-Condition: Full price badge control set to off. A full price product (list price in the full price pricebook, no lower price in the hard markdown pricebook) with a layered promotion.
Steps:
1. Open the PLP that contains the product.
2. Check the product tile.
Expected: No automated £ or % badge is shown on the full price product.

Title: TFGTRS-4604 - Full price badge on, percentage mode: "20% Off" for a 20% off all full price promotion
Pre-Condition: Full price badge control on and set to % off. A promotion "20% off all full price" active on the brand.
Steps:
1. Open a PLP with full price products in the promotion.
2. Check the badge.

Title: TFGTRS-4604 - Full price badge switched to £ off
Pre-Condition: Full price badge control on and set to £ off. A line-list promotion (e.g. up to £100 off coats) where each product gets a different discount.
Steps:
1. Open the PLP.
2. Check the badge of each promoted product.
Expected: Each badge shows the £ amount calculated from the original full price minus the promotion price (e.g. £20 off, £40 off).

Title: TFGTRS-4604 - Promotion using a pricebook: difference against the original list price
Pre-Condition: A promotion that uses a pricebook for the promotional price.
Steps:
1. Open the PLP.
2. Compare the badge with the full price list price and the promotion price.
Expected: The badge is calculated from the difference between the original full price list price and the promotion price.

Title: TFGTRS-4604 - Different promotion types
Pre-Condition: Promotions of different types available on dev (% off, amount off, fixed price).
Steps: 1. For each type of promotion, check the badge on the PLP.
Expected: The badge is correct for each supported type, or absent when the type is not supported.

Title: TFGTRS-4604 - Sale badges on the PLP still look as before the change - Hobbs and Phase Eight
Pre-Condition: Dev environment is accessible (basic auth credentials available). Requested by dev as an interim regression check, before the full-price preferences/pricebooks are confirmed. No Business Manager change needed for this case.
Steps:
1. Open the Sale PLP on Hobbs.
2. Open the Sale PLP on Phase Eight.
3. Check the % or £ off badge on a sample of sale products on each brand.
Expected: The sale badges show the same % or £ off as before this ticket, with no visual regression or missing badges.

Title: TFGTRS-4604 - Sale / hard markdown badges are not affected by the new full price controls
Pre-Condition: Business Manager access on dev. Sale products with a lower price in the hard markdown pricebook. Needs the full price preferences confirmed by dev.
Steps:
1. Change the full price controls (on / off, % / £).
2. Check the badges on sale products.
3. Change the sale controls and check the full price products.
Expected: Sale badges (e.g. 40% off, 50% off) keep working as before. Sale and full price controls are independent of each other.

Title: TFGTRS-4604 - Full price products without a promotion show no badge
Pre-Condition: Full price product with no promotion. The earlier bug showed £ and % badges on full price products.
Steps: 1. Open the PLP and check full price products without a promotion.

Title: TFGTRS-4604 - Product with a lower price in the hard markdown pricebook is treated as sale
Pre-Condition: Product with a price in the hard markdown pricebook and a layered promotion.
Steps: 1. Open the PLP and check the badge.
Expected: The product follows the sale badge controls, not the full price controls.

Title: TFGTRS-4604 - Badges behave the same on Hobbs and Phase Eight
Pre-Condition: Per dev, this ticket only affects Hobbs and Phase Eight. Whistles and Inside Story are out of scope.
Steps:
1. Repeat the main checks on Hobbs.
2. Repeat the main checks on Phase Eight.
Expected: The behaviour is the same on both brands.
